spec.description: vLLM + Node Exporter dashboard for DGX Spark/Qwen. Added ultra-thin cloud-vs-local cost strip at top. NVIDIA-inspired visual theme: #76B900 green, dark gray, white, minimal high-contrast styling. NVIDIA refined theme uses #76B900 green, #1E1E1E dark gray, and white as the base palette, with amber/red reserved for operational warning states.

spec.title: TOTAL TOKENS (RANGE)
spec.description: Prompt + output tokens generated within the selected Grafana time range. The large value is a range total; the small sparkline shows rate/shape, not a cumulative counter.
Opus-class cloud equivalent for selected range: $5 input / $25 output per 1M tokens.
Sonnet-class cloud equivalent for selected range: $3 input / $15 output per 1M tokens.
Haiku-class cloud equivalent for selected range: $1 input / $5 output per 1M tokens.
Estimated local electricity cost for selected range: 240W at $0.151/kWh.

spec.title: KV CACHE USED
spec.description: Percent of vLLM KV cache blocks currently used. This is not total GPU memory; it is the allocated KV cache pressure.

spec.title: PREFIX CACHE HIT RATE
spec.description: 0% can be normal if prefix caching is disabled or if prompts are not being reused.

spec.expr: 100 * ((sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits[$__rate_interval])) or sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries[$__rate_interval])) or sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1))

spec.title: SPEC DECODE ACCEPTANCE BY POSITION
spec.description: Speculative-decoding acceptance by draft position. Each bar is accepted tokens at that position / speculative drafts. vLLM labels positions zero-based: Position 0 is the first proposed draft token, Position 1 is the second, and so on. The panel automatically shows however many positions vLLM exposes for the configured num_speculative_tokens.

spec.title: TIME TO FIRST TOKEN P50 / P95 / P99
spec.description: How long users wait before the first streamed token appears. Sensitive to prompt size, queueing, and prefill.

spec.title: INTER-TOKEN LATENCY / TPOT
spec.description: Time between generated output tokens. Lower is better for streaming responsiveness. Moved out of the top row because it is a latency diagnostic, not a throughput headline.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: QUEUE TIME P50 / P95 / P99
spec.description: Scheduler wait time before work starts. This is one of the clearest contention signals.

spec.title: END-TO-END REQUEST LATENCY P50 / P95 / P99
spec.description: Total request duration from arrival to completion.

spec.title: PROMPT SIZE DISTRIBUTION
spec.description: Prompt token size distribution for completed requests.

spec.title: OUTPUT SIZE DISTRIBUTION
spec.description: Generated token size distribution for completed requests.

spec.title: OUTPUT TOKENS (RANGE)
spec.description: Generated/decode tokens within the selected time range.

spec.title: PROMPT VS OUTPUT TOKEN MIX
spec.description: Prompt tokens/sec indicates prefill/context ingestion. Output tokens/sec indicates decode generation. Large prompt bursts with low output TPS usually means context/prefill dominated workload.

spec.title: MODEL THROUGHPUT COMPARISON
spec.description: Useful when you temporarily run or compare multiple vLLM model names.

spec.title: CPU UTILIZATION
spec.description: Host CPU utilization from Node Exporter.

spec.title: MEMORY UTILIZATION
spec.description: Host RAM utilization from Node Exporter.

spec.title: ROOT DISK UTILIZATION
spec.description: Root filesystem space utilization.

spec.title: LOAD / CPU CORE
spec.description: 1-minute Linux load average divided by CPU core count. Under 1.0/core normally means no CPU run-queue contention.

spec.title: NETWORK THROUGHPUT RX / TX
spec.description: Network receive/transmit bytes per second across non-container interfaces.

spec.title: DISK THROUGHPUT READ / WRITE
spec.description: Disk read/write bytes per second.

spec.title: INPUT TOKENS (RANGE)
spec.description: Prompt/prefill tokens within the selected time range.

spec.title: CPU: USER / SYSTEM / IOWAIT
spec.description: CPU breakdown. Watch iowait if disk stalls line up with vLLM latency.

spec.title: MEMORY: USED / AVAILABLE / CACHE
spec.description: Memory used, available, and cache.

spec.title: DISK: READ / WRITE BYTES
spec.description: Disk read/write bytes per second over time.

spec.title: NETWORK: RX / TX
spec.description: Network receive/transmit throughput over time.

spec.title: FILESYSTEM SPACE BY MOUNT
spec.description: Filesystem usage by mountpoint.

spec.title: DISK IOPS
spec.description: Disk operations per second.

spec.title: TOTAL TOKENS / SEC
spec.description: Real-time prompt + output token throughput. Higher is good only when queueing, preemption, and latency stay controlled.

spec.title: VLLM ENGINE ITERATION LATENCY
spec.description: Engine iteration metrics if exposed by your vLLM version.

spec.title: HTTP LATENCY BY HANDLER
spec.description: HTTP request duration by handler if FastAPI instrumentation is exposed.

spec.title: PROCESS RSS / CPU IF EXPOSED
spec.description: Python process metrics if exposed by your vLLM Prometheus client mode.

spec.title: OUTPUT TOKENS / SEC
spec.description: Decode throughput only. This is the model actively producing answer tokens.

spec.title: SPEC DECODE ACCEPTANCE
spec.description: Overall speculative-decoding draft-token acceptance rate. Calculated as accepted draft tokens / drafted tokens over Grafana's current rate interval. Higher means more proposed draft tokens are being accepted by the target model.

spec.title: REQUEST HOPPER: RUNNING / WAITING / SWAPPED
spec.description: Running = actively being served. Waiting = queued but not yet scheduled. Swapped = KV/cache pressure caused requests to be moved out of active GPU cache.

spec.title: TOKEN THROUGHPUT OVER TIME
spec.description: Prompt/prefill tokens and output/decode tokens per second over time.

spec.title: REQUEST RATE / SUCCESS / ERRORS
spec.description: API request flow. Non-2xx should normally stay at zero unless clients are disconnecting, timing out, or sending bad requests.

spec.title: DGX Spark — Throughput Without Contention v7 Real GPU Fixed + NVIDIA Refined Theme
